justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: Flow cytometry dot plots show fluorescence intensity for markers (e.g., SOX17-Tom, NKX2-5-GFP, PDGFRα, CD235) on the x-axis but do not indicate units; fluorescence is typically in arbitrary fluorescence units but this is not labeled.

Flow cytometry dot plots show fluorescence intensity on the y-axis (e.g., PDGFRα-BV421, CD235-APC) with no explicit units; percentages for gated populations are shown but axis values lack unit specification.
